subject: Hosted API integration: technical workshop & SDK/streaming plan
messages:
From: Sam Bradley <sam.bradley@claritycare.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@claritycare.io>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + request: hosted integration deep-dive (SDKs / streaming / tool calls)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick product demo last week — ClarityCare’s engineering team wants to run a technical deep-dive focused on how to integrate Redwood’s hosted API into our ingestion and care-coordination flows. Key asks from our side:

- SDK recommendations for Node + Python (auth, retries, timeouts)
- Streaming best practices for partial results and txn-level latency
- How function/tool calling maps to our task queue + webhook processing
- Quantization / cost options for long transcripts

Would your team be available for a 60–75 minute session next week? Preferred windows: Wed 12/9 10–12 PT, Thu 12/10 1–3 PT, or Fri 12/11 morning PT. We’ll have two engineers (Hannah and me) and our platform lead on the call.

I attached a short requirements PDF that highlights our throughput/latency expectations.

Best,
Sam

Attachments: claritycare-integration-requirements.pdf (PDF, 65KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sam Bradley <sam.bradley@claritycare.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request: hosted integration deep-dive (SDKs / streaming / tool calls)

Hi Sam — great to hear and thanks for the PDF, that’s helpful. Karthik (SDKs/retries) and Marcus (streaming/runtime) are looped in. We can run a 75-minute technical workshop that covers your bullets and a short Q&A. Proposed agenda:

1) 10 min - goals and current infra (you)
2) 20 min - SDK auth patterns, retry/backoff, tracing hooks (Karthik)
3) 20 min - streaming & partial-response handling + latency SLOs (Marcus)
4) 15 min - tool/function calling design patterns + webhook examples (Kimberly)
5) 10 min - next steps & mutual action plan

Available slots (PT):
- Thu 2026-12-10 13:00–14:15 PT
- Fri 2026-12-11 09:00–10:15 PT
- Fri 2026-12-11 11:00–12:15 PT

Please confirm which slot works and whether you want us to record the session and share the runbook afterwards. I attached our one-pager on hosted architecture to give your infra team context.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Partner Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-hosted-arch-onepager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Sam Bradley <sam.bradley@claritycare.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request: hosted integration deep-dive (SDKs / streaming / tool calls)

Kimberly — thanks, that agenda looks perfect. We’ll take the Fri 12/11 09:00–10:15 PT slot. 

Quick add-on: our security lead may join for the first 15 minutes with a couple of SOC2/data retention questions — can we include a 10-minute window to cover logging/retention & request tracing?

Confirmed attendees from ClarityCare: Sam Bradley (platform), Hannah Lee (engineer), Priya Nair (security) — Priya may join for the first part.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Sam

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Fri 2026-12-11 09:00–10:15 PT (75 minutes). I created the calendar invite and added a shared Google Meet link. High-level assignments:

- Intro & current infra (Sam/Hannah) — 09:00–09:10 PT
- SDK patterns (Karthik) — 09:10–09:30 PT
- Streaming & latency (Marcus) — 09:30–09:50 PT
- Function/tool calling + webhook patterns (Kimberly) — 09:50–10:05 PT

Notes / prep: please review ClarityCare’s requirements PDF ahead of time (attached in the thread). I’ll record and upload the session runbook + example snippets to the HubSpot deal page.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=claritycare-20261211-0900
